text_block_list.text:
Yes! Actually, thanks to the new aroma diffuser,

and I ended up making an oil that smells soooo good!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'll share some with you next time, Trainer~!

It seemed Hishi Miracle was able to spend
a very fulfilling day off.
